title: GL-01 — Identity, budget, and preflight
body: Create one IAM lab user with MFA and a permissions boundary, plus one alert-only budget. Same-hour estimate is $0. You run every command. Do not create access keys and do not use the root user.
stopChargesPanel: Delete the lab user, MFA device, boundary policy, and budget when you finish or stop early. IAM users, policies, MFA devices, and alert-only budgets carry no charge, so nothing in this lab bills hourly or otherwise.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using the named profile you already use, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: `$env:AWS_PROFILE` prints your profile name and `$env:AWS_REGION` prints us-east-1.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: the JSON shows an Account and an Arn whose path contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`.
Stop if the Arn contains `:root`.
Copy the Account value into `$AccountId` for later commands.
Do not paste the output into this app.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: the first token starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab does not use Terraform.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Same-hour estimate is $0.
Forgotten-overnight estimate is $0 because this lab creates no hourly resource.
An alert-only budget has no charge.
$10 alerts warn you. They do not stop spend.
Success: you can say both estimates before you create anything.

steps.title: Create the lab IAM user
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's date (same calendar day), for example 2026-09-25.
Run `aws iam create-user --user-name workbook-gl01 --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-01 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`.
Success: the output UserName is workbook-gl01.
Do not run `aws iam create-access-key`.

steps.title: Create the permissions boundary
bullets: Save gl01-boundary.json with Version 2012-10-17 and two statements.
First statement: Allow Action * on Resource *.
Second statement: Deny cloudhsm:*, shield:*, directconnect:*, and outposts:* on Resource *.
Those four denies are the whole extra restriction.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl01-boundary.json", '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowAll","Effect":"Allow","Action":"*","Resource":"*"},{"Sid":"DenyRestrictedServices","Effect":"Deny","Action":["cloudhsm:*","shield:*","directconnect:*","outposts:*"],"Resource":"*"}]}', $utf8)`.

Run `aws iam create-policy --policy-name gl01-boundary --policy-document file://gl01-boundary.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-01 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`.
Success: the output Arn ends in policy/gl01-boundary. Copy that Arn into `$BoundaryArn`.

steps.title: Attach the boundary to the user
bullets: Run `aws iam put-user-permissions-boundary --user-name workbook-gl01 --permissions-boundary $BoundaryArn`.
Success: the command exits 0.
`aws iam get-user --user-name workbook-gl01` shows PermissionsBoundary with that Arn.

steps.title: Create a virtual MFA device
bullets: Run `aws iam create-virtual-mfa-device --virtual-mfa-device-name workbook-gl01 --outfile "$env:TEMP\gl01-mfa.png" --bootstrap-method QRCodePNG`.
Success: a SerialNumber Arn is printed and the PNG exists.
Treat the PNG and the Base32 seed as secrets.
Do not commit them or paste them here.

steps.title: Enable MFA on the lab user
bullets: Enroll the QR in an authenticator.
Run `aws iam enable-mfa-device --user-name workbook-gl01 --serial-number <SerialNumber Arn> --authentication-code1 <current code> --authentication-code2 <next code>`.
The two codes must be consecutive.
Success: `aws iam list-mfa-devices --user-name workbook-gl01` lists that serial.
Delete the PNG after enrollment.

steps.title: Create the alert-only budget
bullets: Save gl01-budget.json as BudgetName workbook-gl01, BudgetLimit Amount 10 Unit USD, TimeUnit MONTHLY, BudgetType COST.
The 10 is only the budget baseline. Alerts are separate and do not stop spend.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl01-budget.json", '{"BudgetName":"workbook-gl01","BudgetLimit":{"Amount":"10","Unit":"USD"},"TimeUnit":"MONTHLY","BudgetType":"COST"}', $utf8)`.
Run `aws budgets create-budget --account-id $AccountId --budget file://gl01-budget.json`.
Do not call `create-budget-action`.
Success: `aws budgets describe-budget --account-id $AccountId --budget-name workbook-gl01` returns that name.

steps.title: Add email alerts, not actions
bullets: Run `aws budgets create-notification --account-id $AccountId --budget-name workbook-gl01 --notification NotificationType=ACTUAL,ComparisonOperator=GREATER_THAN,Threshold=<amount>,ThresholdType=ABSOLUTE_VALUE --subscribers SubscriptionType=EMAIL,Address=<your-email>`.
Use ACTUAL amounts 2, 5, and 8.
Repeat with NotificationType=FORECASTED for amounts 5 and 8.
Success: `aws budgets describe-notifications-for-budget` lists those five alerts.
No budget action exists.

steps.title: Confirm there is no access key
bullets: Run `aws iam list-access-keys --user-name workbook-gl01`.
Success: AccessKeyMetadata is empty.
If a key exists, delete it with `aws iam delete-access-key` before you continue.
Do not create root access keys.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Deactivate MFA.
Delete the virtual MFA device.
Remove the permissions boundary.
Delete the user.
Delete the boundary policy.
Delete the budget.
Success: that order is on screen in Stop charges. Dependents come first.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run the Stop charges commands yourself, top to bottom.
Success: `aws iam get-user --user-name workbook-gl01` returns NoSuchEntity.
`aws budgets describe-budget --account-id $AccountId --budget-name workbook-gl01` returns NotFound.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: In the Billing console, look up this account's charges for today after the usual 8–12 hour lag.
Record the actual amount in your own notes.
Expect $0 for this lab.
Alerts do not delete resources, and time already used can still appear.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws iam get-user --user-name workbook-gl01 returns NoSuchEntity
aws budgets describe-budget --account-id $AccountId --budget-name workbook-gl01 returns NotFound
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-01 returns an empty list in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alert-only budgets have no charge. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If a command fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller Arn is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any further delete. List only LabId=gl-01 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-01. Refuse the list when it is empty or larger than the user, policy, and budget from this lab. Delete only those ids, never untagged resources.
